en.headline: Wang Fuk Court owners’ special sales scheme balloting sets selection order
en.dek: Computer random draw results for the first batch were released this morning; full results will be posted on the scheme website around 3pm.
body: The Housing Bureau held a computerised random balloting on Tuesday morning for the special sales scheme offered to Wang Fuk Court owners who accepted the government’s acquisition offer after last year’s fire.

The first-batch draw, covering owners who submitted acceptance letters by 30 June, produced the top ten application-number endings in the order 25, 28, 75, 12, 56, 99, 59, 64, 36 and 47. The scheme ranks applicants by the last two digits of their application numbers; within the same digits the computer assigns the final selection sequence.

A second batch covering acceptances received between 1 July and 31 August was also drawn. Full random-ordering results for both batches are scheduled to be uploaded to the scheme website around 3pm today.

The government has reserved more than 4,400 subsidised-sale flats across ten Housing Authority and Housing Society developments in Kowloon Bay, Kai Tak, Tseung Kwan O, Kwun Tong, Tai Po and other districts for eligible owners. Prices range from about HK$1.5 million to more than HK$5.3 million. Flat selection is expected to begin later this month.

zh.headline: 宏福苑特設銷售計劃攪珠 定出業主揀樓次序
zh.dek: 上午進行電腦隨機排序，第一批頭十個申請編號尾數為25、28、75等，完整結果約下午3時上載網站。
body: 房屋局周二上午為宏福苑業主「特設銷售計劃」進行電腦隨機排序攪珠，以決定已接受政府收購建議的業主揀樓先後次序。
第一批（6月30日或之前交回接受收購建議信件的業主）攪珠結果，首十個申請編號最後兩個數字順序為25、28、75、12、56、99、59、64、36、47。計劃按申請編號最後兩個數字排列次序，相同尾數的申請者再由電腦隨機決定最終揀樓順序。
第二批（7月1日至8月31日接受收購的業主）亦已進行攪珠。兩批完整電腦隨機排序結果預計今日下午約3時上載至計劃網站。
政府已預留房屋委員會及房屋協會合共十個發展項目內超過4,400個單位，供已向政府出售宏福苑單位業權的業主選購或「樓換樓」。涉及屋苑位於九龍灣、啟德、將軍澳、觀塘及大埔等地，售價由約150多萬至530多萬不等，預計本月稍後開始揀樓。
